correctness.rationale: For H(d,q), q>=2,d>=1,1<=t<=d, root-normalize to a=0^d,b=1^t0^(d-t). Four type counts alpha,beta,gamma on t changed coordinates and delta on remaining coordinates are exactly orbits of obvious coordinate/symbol permutations preserving both roots. Their distances are u=beta+gamma+delta, v=alpha+gamma+delta, while the number f of neighbors with both distances decreased by one equals delta (only one replacement per selected nonzero unchanged-coordinate symbol). Thus alpha=t+f-u,beta=t+f-v,gamma=u+v-t-2f. Equitability of the stabilized individualization partition implies distance-pair and local f are constant on each stable cell, proving orbit equality; automorphisms forbid a finer partition. Distance-pair cells determine delta without refinement iff q=2 or t=1 or t=d, otherwise explicit feasible tuples (t-2,0,2,0),(t-1,1,0,1) share distances but have different f, and one round fixes it. Orbit sizes and class counts follow from multinomial/binomial counts. Independently constructed 1-WL and checked five q,d,t instances, including H(3,3) with t=2.
